rejection_findings.finding: Cited claim and relation support purity, truth, and comparative value, but not proportion or the forward-looking later-ranking claim.

revisions.body: The analogy of pure whiteness shifts the comparison from intensity to mixture. A small pleasure free from pain can be more pleasant, truer, and more beautiful—and of greater comparative value—than a large mixed pleasure: the pure and unmixed outranks the intense.
